description: This PHP class, UserTestDataGenerator, is responsible for creating and updating test user data within the database. It initializes specific users with predefined attributes for testing purposes using the UserRepository.

classes.name: UserTestDataGenerator
classes.description: A readonly class designed to generate test user data by updating existing users and creating new test users in the database.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Populates the database with predefined test user data, updating the user with ID 1 and creating three new users.
